context:
Goal: every artifact, on both accounts, lives in git and works anywhere.
Problem (goal): a claude.ai page cannot call out (item 593, 12:35 CST Nov 12), so git is written only by a session. You asked at 12:03 CST for 'multiple accounts iwht their own artifacts and design work each having to be merged in super artifacts'. Today `export_page.py --merge` joins two accounts' pages for one repo (step page-merge-two-accounts, #2424).
Based on (ruling): page-git-is-home (your Nov 2 words and 730 a).
Based on (read): blind Opus review 12:13 CST Nov 13, relayed by the retrospective.
Departs from: main — each account keeps its own page, merged into git by a session; b adds one live page across both accounts.
Meanwhile: the git-home lane builds the parts both options need.

options.gain: No host and no token; builds on what exists.
options.how: Each account's pages export to git, and any page rebuilds from git on either account.
options.label: Git is the meeting point (retrospective's pick, recommended)
options.lose: Two live pages, one per account, synced through git at each writer wake.

options.gain: One page; git written at the click, no session needed.
options.how: A small host (a Cloudflare Worker holding a repo-scoped GitHub token) writes git at the click.
options.label: One live page across both accounts, served by a host
options.lose: A host to run, a token that cannot be limited to one branch, and an access gate.

reply: Closed 12:23 CST Nov 13: already ruled. Decision waiting-data-in-repo (your Nov 2 14:58 CST words) says git is each artifact's home and each claude.ai link is one account's view; you leaned the same way at 12:17 CST. The retrospective withdrew the question. Reopen if you want a host that serves both accounts live.
short: Two accounts: merge in git, or one live page?

shown.label: Git is the meeting point (retrospective's pick, recommended)
One live page across both accounts, served by a host

title: To bring your two accounts' pages together, should git be the meeting point, or should one live page serve both accounts through a host?
why: Both options cost something you would have to live with; the retrospective picks a.
